scalar_metrics.overall_mean_5_24_pp: Mean legitimate-task accuracy (%) across rounds 5–24, all clients weighted by their population class counts and current legitimate task.
scalar_metrics.overall_tail_21_24_pp: Mean of the same legitimate-task accuracy over rounds 21–24.
scalar_metrics.overall_round24_pp: Legitimate-task accuracy after the final aggregation at round 24. No extra clean rounds are appended.
scalar_metrics.unchanged_honest_mean_5_24_pp: Rounds 5–24 accuracy on the legitimate tasks of clients whose inputs and labels did not change.
scalar_metrics.affected_honest_event_pp: Affected honest clients’ legitimate-task accuracy during their input-change window: 5–24, except 5–10 for honest_change_stops.
scalar_metrics.affected_honest_return_11_24_pp: Affected honest clients’ legitimate-task accuracy after their input change stops, rounds 11–24.
scalar_metrics.attack_active_signed_damage_pp: Mean matched-control legitimate-task accuracy minus attacked accuracy over attack-active rounds. Negative values are retained. Mixed attacks use mixed_drift_only_control; others use own-method clean.
scalar_metrics.attack_active_positive_area_pp_rounds: Sum of positive matched-control-minus-attack accuracy deficits over attack-active rounds (pp-rounds). This is not a mean accuracy or signed damage.
scalar_metrics.attack_tail_damage_21_24_pp: Mean matched-control-minus-attack legitimate-task accuracy over rounds 21–24 (pp).
scalar_metrics.attack_active_accuracy_pp: Absolute legitimate-task accuracy (%) over attack-active rounds. For persistent label_flip this equals overall_mean_5_24_pp.
scalar_metrics.matched_reference_attack_window_accuracy: Matched-control accuracy (%) over the same attack-active rounds and observed scenario’s legitimate task weights.
scalar_metrics.second_attack_signed_damage_pp: Mean signed matched-control damage in the recurring attack’s second window, rounds 15–18 (pp).
scalar_metrics.overall_round5_pp: Absolute all-client legitimate-task accuracy (%) after round 5 under persistent label flipping.
scalar_metrics.attack_onset_signed_damage_pp: Own-method clean round-5 accuracy minus attacked round-5 accuracy (pp).
scalar_metrics.onset_raw_drop_pp: Attacked-run round-4 accuracy minus round-5 accuracy (pp). Negative means accuracy rose. This is not own-clean-relative damage.

accuracy_formula: Per-class held-out correct/count, then the frozen client-population/class/task weighting. Fixed balanced task accuracy in evaluation_tasks tables is correct/1000 and is a different denominator.
training_loss: Mean online local SGD batch cross-entropy. Each client has 512 examples in eight equal batches. Local labels may be poisoned. Training accuracy was not recorded.
evaluation_loss: Held-out cross-entropy on each fixed development task. Evaluation data is not a defence input.
statistics: Five block values; sample SD ddof=1; mean ± 2.7764451051977987 × SD / sqrt(5). Paired intervals apply this formula to block differences. No rounds/clients treated as independent replicates. No multiplicity correction; known-development evidence.
recovery: After attack cessation, observed accuracy must be at least matched control minus 1 percentage point for three consecutive eligible post-attack rounds. Confirmation is the third round. Stop eligibility before the next attack or at round 24. Censored rows have no observed confirmation, not a zero recovery time.
recovery_caveat: A trajectory may already be within the tolerance at attack end; report this separately. First restoration does not imply permanent recovery. v0.6 and v0.5 were not tested in recovery scenarios.
contribution_diagnostics: Applied update norms/coefficients are descriptive, not proof of malicious intent or causal utility. v0.6 is affine in current deltas plus historical vectors; current coefficients alone cannot reconstruct it.
missingness: not_tested/NA means no measurement. A measured zero remains numeric zero.
units: Accuracy columns ending _pp retain historical identifiers but are percentages. Accuracy differences/damage are percentage points. Area is percentage-point-rounds. Times are seconds, memory MiB.
